scope: Offline Rust desktop .forma file and recovery sidecar

verification.dependencies: no new external crate or version changes

contract.transport: serialized NDJSON stdio, trusted Electron main only
contract.format: existing .forma JSON schemas1–6 with kernel validation
contract.conflictGuard: SHA-256 checked before temp write and immediately before atomic replacement; not OS-wide CAS

limitations: Linux only in this run; Windows/macOS binaries not built or executed
No GUI, IME, native GPU, installer or signing acceptance
Fault injection covers precommit failure and postcommit directory sync warning, not actual power loss/disk-full hardware
Existing-target hash check/rename retains an unavoidable race against unrelated writers
No full ACL/xattr/ownership preservation; no Windows directory fsync via std
New-file atomic create requires filesystem hard-link support
No full kernel-suite rerun: kernel source unchanged in this task; prior evidence retained
evidence_status: Historical pre-quality-repair snapshot; source/artifact hashes and test results apply only to that captured version.
